newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenyan tea prices firm at weekly auction.
newsitem.headline: Kenyan tea prices firm at weekly auction.

text.p: Kenyan tea prices were firmer at the weekly export auction in the coastal resort of Mombasa on Monday, auction officials said.
"There was very strong demand particularly for better quality," one official said.
Brighter BP1s gained 12-20 U.S. cents while lower mediums edged 3-9 cents. Brighter pdusts went up 5-12 cents while lower medium PF1s gained 5-9 cents.
Fannings and dusts gained value while tended easier.
Pakistan was forceful while Egypt remained strong.
